items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: Like little Sammy. I remember that time in Algiers. We lugged him. We took turns in carrying him.

ctx.x: Well, who all did you meet as you walk along with them?

Well, you meet all kinds of people. Surprisingly enough, people which you've never seen before. All of a sudden, here you are talking to somebody you've never known before. And as you follow the parade. And sometimes it's just a lady who lives in the neighborhood. And she's lugging her child along with her, you know. Like little Sammy. I remember that time in Algiers. We lugged him. We took turns in carrying him. And of course, you meet the musicians too. And that's a great big thing. They always greet you and…
They really treat you with respect, you know.
